text: The Food Nutrition and Health major is rooted inemphasizingtheandmedicine，integrationcomplementarity of multiple disciplines to merge"medicine and health." This program is designed tocultivate highly specialized professionals with expertisein scientific research on food nutrition, the developmentof functional foods, and the promotion of health anddisease prevention.The major boasts a highly qualified faculty, with90% holding doctoral degrees, including eight nationaland provincial-level experts. It is supported by aprovincial-level technological innovation center, a keylaboratory, and an experimental teaching demonstrationcenter. Additionally,the program has established 10off-campus practice bases and maintains strongcollaborative relationships with provincial nutritionsocieties and large-scale hospitals, providing studentswith high-quality teaching,hands-on training, andresearch opportunities.
